entities.summary: The Tobu Tojo Line  is a 75.0 km (46.6 mi) suburban railway line in Japan which runs from Ikebukuro Station in Toshima, Tokyo to Yorii Station in Yorii, Saitama, operated by the private railway operator Tobu Railway. Its official name is the Tobu Tojo Main Line , but it is referred to as Tobu Tojo Line  on Tobu signage and publicity information.
